name: layout
description: Layout changes: columns, headers, footers, restructuring

prompts.prompt: Add a header section at the top with a placeholder logo on the left and a navigation area on the right. The header should span the full width.
prompts.expectedBehavior: New header element added, existing content preserved

prompts.prompt: Add a footer section at the bottom with placeholder text for copyright and contact information. The footer should span the full width.
prompts.expectedBehavior: New footer element added, existing content preserved

prompts.prompt: Reorganize the main content into a two-column layout. Put the primary content in a wider left column (70%) and add a sidebar on the right (30%).
If there are list items or repeated sections, convert them to a responsive grid layout with 3 columns on desktop.
prompts.expectedBehavior: List converted to grid, items preserved

prompts.prompt: Wrap all content in a centered container with a maximum width of 960px and horizontal auto margins.
